title: Find the full names and hometown cities of members who incurred food expens
question: Find the full names and hometown cities of members who incurred food expenses during the 'September Meeting' that were above the average cost of all food expenses for that event.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  T1."XCL_035" AS "first_name",
  T1."XCL_036" AS "last_name",
  T4."XCL_045" AS "hometown_city"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN event AS T5 ON T3."XCL_009" = T5."XCL_010"
LEFT JOIN zip_code AS T4 ON T1."XCL_041" = T4."XCL_043"
WHERE T5."XCL_011" = 'September Meeting'
  AND T3."XCL_004" = 'Food'
  AND T2."XCL_020" > (
    SELECT AVG(T2b."XCL_020")
    FROM expense AS T2b
    INNER JOIN budget AS T3b ON T2b."XCL_023" = T3b."XCL_003"
    INNER JOIN event AS T5b ON T3b."XCL_009" = T5b."XCL_010"
    WHERE T5b."XCL_011" = 'September Meeting'
      AND T3b."XCL_004" = 'Food'
  )
